 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Rajnesh Oswal, Judge

The petitioner, who is serving as Wing Commander in the Air Force Station, Srinagar, has come up with this petition for assailing the FIR bearing No. 0370/2024 dated 08.09.2024, registered with the Police Station Budgam, at the instance of respondent no. 2, for the commission of offence under Section 376(2) of IPC, on the ground that respondent no. 2, had earlier filed a complaint of sexual harassment against the petitioner on 23.01.2024, pursuant to which, Court of Inquiry was constituted, but was subsequently cancelled and, thereafter, a new Internal Committee (IC), was constituted by the Competent Authority, and the Committee returned the findings that the subject matter remains inconclusive and not proved against the petitioner vide findings dated 15.05.2024.
2. It is contended by the learned counsel for the petitioner that it was only when the said findings were returned by the IC, the respondent no. 2 lodged the present FIR.
Notice is waived by Mr. Alla ud Din Ganie, learned AAG, on behalf of the respondent no. 1.
He shall file response by or before the next date of hearing.
4. Notice shall go to respondent no. 2, through SHO concerned.
